primitives.breakdown_regime: Monotonic decreasing in yardline and yards-to-go, restricted to τ ∈ [0.2, 0.8]

layer2.mapping: Spline smoothing enables interpolation of τ across continuous field positions; GSE uses this to generalize across sparse data
layer2.telemetry: Smoothed τ estimates per field position and WP bin

reasoning_traces.think:
The core operator is inverse optimization that infers implicit risk preferences τ from observed 4th-down decisions. This is modeled as a minimization of Hamming loss between actual and τ-optimal actions. The forward model is a one-step MDP with defined rewards for TD, FG, SAF, and a fixed policy π̄ for future states. The τ estimates are then smoothed using SCAM splines to handle spatial discontinuities and reduce selection bias. These primitives form a dual system: inverse optimization maps behavior to risk, while the MDP provides a decision framework. Failure modes include overfitting due to small sample sizes, misalignment of π̄ with actual play-calling, and extrapolation beyond the valid τ range [0.2, 0.8].
